idea-plugin.name: Lite
idea-plugin.description:
Lightweight language support for reading and checking code written by agents. Everything runs inside the IDE (no language server), and only what reading needs is there.

Features

  • Highlighting: lexer colors plus structure (declarations, calls, types, parameters).
  • Ctrl/Cmd+Click: go to the definition, with enough type inference to follow a.b().c; into dependencies (std, Cargo crates, Gradle cache, venv, node_modules, Qt) and linked files.
  • Rename: declarations and every use (in place for locals).
  • Find Usages: honouring the scope picked in the dialog.
  • Left out on purpose: completion, import management, inspections, formatting, run/debug, tool windows.

With Lite, TextMate Bundles is not needed for these. Disable the plugins Lite replaces: Lite takes their file types.

Rust grammar derived from intellij-rust (MIT); Kotlin lexer/parser derived from the Kotlin compiler (Apache 2.0); Python lexer/parser from intellij-community (Apache 2.0); Protocol Buffers lexer/grammar from protoeditor (Apache 2.0) and Google's well-known types (BSD-3). Everything else written for Lite.
